comment: It was fun to have a prof that was a UR grad. Dr. Bell really likes to talk about Shakespeare and get into the details which is helpful to for writing the papers. The final was a take home exam and he gave clear instructions. Go to office hours-- great for combing through ideas and getting started on your papers.

I took Dr. Bell's Shakespeare course as a Gen Ed. I would recommend it to anyone looking to do the same. It was an easy course to clear the requirement. Bell is a great prof, but you will read your ass off which can be mundane at times. Only two papers, both 4-5 pages, so no biggie. He can be a tough grader though, but you can still get an A or B.
